subject: domain: decouple info schema syncer (#61794)
summary: Reviewed cc70f143 relative to its first parent, focusing on the infoschema sync/validation refactor: new `pkg/infoschema/issyncer` (reload + sync loop + MDL check + loader), moved schema validator to `pkg/infoschema/isvalidator` behind `pkg/infoschema/validatorapi`, and domain wiring (`Domain.Reload`, `GetSnapshotInfoSchema`, `GetSchemaValidator`, sysvar hook). Core metadata/state-machine behaviors (schema version load/diff fallback, schema-version syncer restart semantics, lease renewal/validator checks, MDL-driven self-version updates, v1/v2 cache switching) match the pre-refactor domain implementations; no remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, concurrency, or metadata handling within the requested scope.
